0022600016.text: The Chicago Bulls, 1-3 and on a two-game losing streak, visit the Boston Celtics, who are 3-1 and on a three-game winning streak, in this Emirates NBA Cup East Group C matchup. Chicago sits fourth in the Central, two games back, and 11th in the East, with a 1-2 road record, while Boston is first in the Atlantic, second in the East, and 3-0 at home. The Bulls trail the 2026-27 season series 0-1 after losing 134-99 in Boston on October 26, and they lost their 2025-26 series 1-2; Chicago is missing Nic Claxton (hamstring), Patrick Williams (groin soreness), and Tobe Awaka (ankle), and Boston is without Devin Carter (illness).
